name: wariba-platform
description: WARIBA — infrastructure de progression pour traders disciplinés (Afrique francophone).

scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:rls && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm exec turbo run test:integration --concurrency=1
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm exec turbo run test:e2e
scripts.test:rls: node scripts/run-test-gate.mjs DATABASE_URL SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- pnpm exec turbo run test:rls --concurrency=1
scripts.ci: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm boundaries:check && pnpm secrets:scan && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:rls && pnpm test:e2e
